svg.title: STRATOS telemetry architecture (proposed)
svg.desc: Onboard logging, packet construction, radio link, ground validation, ground logging and reconciliation.
svg.text: STRATOS — Telemetry, onboard logging and reconciliation architecture
Proposed design. Records every 100 ms (10 Hz); every 10th record is also transmitted (1 Hz). GFSK 866.0 MHz, 38.4 kb/s, ±40 kHz: 44-byte frame ≈ 11.5 ms on air (1.15 % duty cycle).
written into the same CSV line
10 Post-mission reconciliation (stratos_gs.reconcile) — after the payload is recovered
Inputs: recovered LOG_<session>.CSV + ground_accepted.csv + ground_rejected.csv. Per session: verify every onboard line CRC; check onboard rec_seq continuity;
match each transmitted record (tx = 'T') to the ground packet with the same pkt_seq and compare 13 fields; classify MISSING (no frame / corrupted frame observed),
NOT_TRANSMITTED (tx = 'F'), MISMATCH, GROUND_ONLY. Output: counts of onboard records, packets received, invalid packets, missing sequence numbers, matches, unresolved items.
Three different data objects (kept distinct throughout the design)
integers in packet units; empty field = absent; line CRC
adds rx UTC, receiver ms, RSSI, SNR, seq_event
Example values are from the SIMULATION (session 7, packet 1; synthetic base date 2000-01-01) — not STRATOS measurements.
Where errors occur (E) and are detected (D)
E1 packet lost/corrupted on link → D3 CRC reject, D4 seq gap
E2 sensor read fails/implausible → D1 status flag + sentinel
E3 SD write fails / power cut → D2 SD_WRITE_ERR, line CRC
D5 radio timeout → tx='F' logged onboard
D6 reconciliation explains every gap or reports it
Arrows: solid = data · dashed = control · dotted = radio
